name: Initial URL
description: URL to be scanned. Same meaning as GSA's `initial_url`; kept as `url` because the probe and render_check read that name

name: Entity ID
description: Registry id of the New York body that owns the site (`id` in data/registry.json). Null for sites not yet in the registry. No GSA equivalent

name: Agency
description: Name of the New York body that owns the site. Same role as GSA's `agency`

name: Pool
description: Which group the site was tested with: nyc-registry, city, county, state-authority. No GSA equivalent

name: Source List
description: Which public list the address came from: cisa (CISA .gov list), its-2023 (NYS ITS 55k6-h6qq), abo (NYS ABO 4vym-q77x). Absent for nyc-registry rows, which come from data/crawl_targets.json. Same role as GSA's `source_list_*` flags, as one value instead of one column per list
